In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his pirates]] '''raided''' the Jedi training cruiser [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], which was transporting a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], for its supply of [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] from [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Ohnaka sought to convert the younglings' crystals into easy profit on the black market, however, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] managed to dive the pirates off the ship but she was taken captive, leaving the younglings alone in the deep space.

==Prelude==
[[File:JediCruiser-TG.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi training cruiser ''Crucible''.]]
After a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] consisting of [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] successfully passed a [[Gathering/Legends|test]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]],<ref name="TG" /> [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka]] prepared to escort them back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="ATS" /> In the meantime, as part of their journey, the younglings were to be instructed in the proper construction of their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] under the expert tutelage of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] prime lightsaber designer and engineer,<ref name="EP07Guide" /> [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]].<ref name="ATS" /> Huyang wasted no time introducing the younglings into the basics of determining the styling of their individual lightsabers and gave them the necessary instructions to assemble their lightsabers from the parts he provided, but [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] attacked the ''Crucible'' to steal the younglings' [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] so that he could convert them into easy profit on the black market.<ref name="ATS" />

==The raid==
The pirate saucer pelted the ''Crucible'' with missile strikes aimed at the cruiser's hyperdrive. Tano and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] tried to steer the ship to safety, but it was too large and ungainly and the ''Crucible'' started to lose power. The pirate vessel fired grappling harpoons, and then Ohnaka personally led the pirates boarding the ''Crucible''. In the training room, [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] ordered the younglings to hand over their crystals to him for safekeeping but [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], however, didn't hand his over. Tano then rushed back to the younglings and there Huyang suggested that the younglings hide in the ship's ventilation shafts. Within the ventilation shaft, the younglings heard the pirates walking overhead. Tano ordered [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]] and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] to make their way to the cockpit, find [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and secure the ship's bridge. The rest of the younglings would follow [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] Huyang and seal themselves in the ship's hold and await Tano's command. Tano then intended to reroute the ship's power to the engines so the ''Crucible'' could break free of the pirate ship's grip.<ref name="ATS" />

[[File:CrucibleAttacked-BFR.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Acushnet/Legends|''Acushnet'']] fires on the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']]]]
Zatt and Ganodi finally made their way to the bridge. They were accosted by a pirate, who reached for them through the closing bulkhead door. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] then used his electric pike to shock the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] thug. In the meanwhile, Ohnaka ordered the pirate to smoke the younglings out of the ventilation shaft and secure the crystals, and soon the younglings started coughing as gas grenades filled the ventilation shafts with choking smoke. Huyang lifted the floor panel to emerge in a corridor, and he was immediately throttled by a pirate. The pirates demanded that the captive younglings hand over their crystals. Petro then pulled out his lightsaber, opened its crystal chamber, and inserted his shard. He ignited his blade, looking to fight, but the gleaming blue shaft faded out. The pirate chuckled and snatched the lightsaber, but Petro's lightsaber exploded in the pirate's grip. The younglings and Huyang dashed away from the stunned pirates. Huyang instructed them to continue to the hold. He had been damaged in the explosion and couldn't aid the children in battle.<ref name="ATS" /> At the cruiser's engineering station, Tano began redistributing power from the ship's core. She overrode the emergency power fail-safes.<ref name="EP07Guide" /> Then, she called Zatt at the bridge via comlink to find out if the other younglings have reached the hold, but Zatt had no information for her.<ref name="ATS" />

In the training room, [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]] and [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] set the training remotes to their highest power settings and programmed them for defense. Running about the corridors, Byph lured the pirates into the room. Katooni called Zatt to seal the room from the bridge. The remotes swarmed the Weequays, relentlessly zapping them. Unfortunately, the younglings couldn't make it to the hold. Ohnaka and his pirates stood in the way. The younglings were surrounded by pirates. Huyang closed one of the bulkhead doors, using a built-in welder to seal the controls shut. Ohnaka demanded the young Jedi to hand over the crystals. Suddenly, Tano arrived. She [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] most the pirates out of the way, and demanded that Ohnaka stand down. With the scent of profit in his wrinkled nose, however, Ohnaka was not about to surrender. Tano ignited her lightsabers, and Ohnaka powered up his electro-staff and engaged Tano in battle. Huyang also engaged one of the pirates in a short brawl and defeated him, despite being dismantled in the process. As soon as the younglings and Huyang were safely in the hold, Tano ordered [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]] to break away from the pirate ship, even though she was not secure. The ''Crucible''{{'s}} engines flared to life and pulled away from the saucer. The grappling hooks snapped off and the docking tube bent, and the pirates were sucked down the corridor. Tano and Ohnaka tumbled through the ''Crucible''. Many pirates were blown into vacuum, although some, including Ohnaka, landed back in their own ship. An errant pirate then knocked Tano into the saucer as well as she closed the tube doors. Unaware that Tano was not aboard, the ''Crucible'' blasted off into hyperspace.<ref name="ATS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|This is the ''Crucible'', Calling the Republic fleet, Come in please, We need help.|Katooni|<ref name="BFR" />}}
Hondo then captured Ahsoka, intending to sell her for profit.

After Ohnaka's raid on the ''Crucible'', the younglings called for help,<ref name="BFR" /><ref name="ATS" /> and they were able to contact [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi hailed the younglings and promised<ref name="BFR" /> to send [[Cody/Legends|Commander Cody]]<ref name="EP08Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep508|text="Bound for Rescue" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> to first pick up the stranded younglings. However, Kenobi suffered a [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|surprise attack]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]<ref name="BFR" /> and Kenobi was defeated.<ref name="ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref> Meanwhile, the younglings decided to disobey Kenobi's orders to stay where they were and went to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] in order to [[Rescue on Florrum/Legends|rescue]] Tano on their own.<ref name="BFR" />
